{{Quote|Breaktown's the underbelly of the underbelly. No mingling there. Only corruption and torment.|[[Senya Tirall]]|<ref name="KotFE 7" />}}
'''District 1327''', best known as '''Breaktown''', was a district on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] ruled by corruption and torment of weak by the strong.

==Description==
{{Quote|This is it. Breaktown. Where people who fall on hard times keep falling. Even when the Knights policed the Old World, we never lingered around here for very long.|[[Senya Tirall]]|<ref name="KotFE 7" />}}
[[File:Kaliyo_Djannis_in_Breaktown.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Kaliyo Djannis]] in Breaktown]]
Located below the [[Old World]], Breaktown was the lowest level of Zakuul's urban sprawl. It was a ruined urban wasteland inhabited by outcasts who had fled the authority of the [[Eternal Empire]]. They formed a society ruled by criminals and totally independent to the rest of the planet.<ref name="TOR:TOW">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|The Old World}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[War against Zakuul]], Breaktown was mostly controlled by the [[Heralds of Zildrog]], cultists of a mything serpent-god [[Zildrog]], led by [[The Exalted]]. [[Alliance Commander|The Outlander]] visited Breaktown twice: in the company of [[Senya Tirall]] while looking for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]] in [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="KotFE 7" /> and in the company of [[Kaliyo Djannis]] while planting explosives at the power junctions in [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="KotFE 10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Breaktown appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion, released with Update 4.0.<ref name="KotFE 7" />
